# buildhint の disk full 群を引いた記録（container 1.2.2 / 2026-08-23）
# 引き方: build の RUN で /dev/full に書く（ホストのディスクを埋める必要はない）

$ cat Dockerfile
FROM alpine
RUN dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/full bs=1M count=1
$ cat compose.yaml
services:
  b:
    build: .
    command: "true"

$ opossum up --build

Building b

hint: the build ran out of disk space — Apple's builder pulls multi-GB base images and writes build layers onto the host volume. Free space and retry:
